🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Sector Weakness). Confirmation: weak sector breadth plus pronounced megacap divergence with multiple SP100 names confirmed BELOW TREND, supporting a restrained NEUTRAL call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%) RECOVERY. Materials showing pickup: ECL (1W: +3.80% | 1M: -1.73%) RECOVERY. Consumer Staples mild strength: WMT (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +5.94%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities (1W: -3.17%) and Real Estate (1W: -3.03%) weakest, with Financials weak (1W: -3.03%) and broad BANK stress: MS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -4.90%) BELOW TREND. Technology 1W weakness includes ORCL (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%) BELOW TREND and INTU (1W: -11.42% | 1M: -22.59%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMGN (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND, EMR (1W: +5.06% | 1M: +1.07%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.42% | 1M: -22.59%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -20.11%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.69% | 1M: -24.89%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -12.15%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology and Communication names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: AMGN (1W: +6.35%), PANW (1W: +5.47%), DHR (1W: +5.32%), EMR (1W: +5.06%), AMAT (1W: +4.85%) — all show short-term momentum. Major divergence present (multiple large-cap tech/financials with conflicting 1W vs 1M), so treat moves as tactical opportunities, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology shows short-term weakness: Tech 1W: -1.82% | 1M: +0.44% (24 stocks). Leaders include PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND, but large-cap pressure from ORCL (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -20.11%) BELOW TREND — sector mixed with downside bias.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak on the week: Financials 1W: -3.03% | 1M: -6.26% (20 stocks). Major banks and brokers MS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -4.90%) BELOW TREND; isolated RECOVERY in MA (1W: +0.11% | 1M: -3.97%) but overall sector at risk.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing relative resilience: Healthcare 1W: +1.69% | 1M: -0.54% (17 stocks). Standouts DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND; sector is one of only three positives this week.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
In a NEUTRAL regime favor selective exposure to names showing confirmed strength in Healthcare and Materials (DHR, LLY, ECL) and reduce exposure to high-multiple Tech and stressed Financials that are confirmed BELOW TREND (ORCL, ADBE, MS). Maintain position sizing discipline given the major divergence among megacaps.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.42% | 1M: -22.59%) BELOW TREND, MS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +1.69%) and Materials (1W: +0.26%) — monitor breadth within those sectors. BEARISH: Financials (1W: -3.03%) and Technology (1W: -1.82%) — weakness concentrated in banks and select tech names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch ORCL break below recent monthly support to confirm further downside and INTU if it fails to reclaim short-term support. Monitor PANW and DHR for continuation above recent highs as confirmation of sector leadership, and MS for stabilization above this week's lows as a sign of financials pressure easing.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.
